canDoYue: 你識講發燒同咳嗽，仲識講之後會去藥房。
canDoEn: Describe a fever and a cough, then say you will go to the pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: Good morning. What brings you in to the clinic today, and how do you feel?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。今日咩事嚟診所？你覺得點？
dialogue.say: Good morning. What brings you in to the clinic today, and how do you feel?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have had a fever and cough since Monday, and my sore throat feels worse.
dialogue.glossYue: 我由星期一起發燒同咳嗽，條喉嚨仲差咗。
dialogue.say: I have had a fever and cough since Monday, and my sore throat feels worse.

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: Do you have a headache too, and are you allergic to any medicine we use?
dialogue.glossYue: 你有冇頭痛？你對我哋用嘅藥有冇過敏？
dialogue.say: Do you have a headache too, and are you allergic to any medicine we use?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have had a headache since Monday, and I have no allergy to any medicine.
dialogue.glossYue: 我由星期一起頭痛，我對任何藥都冇過敏。
dialogue.say: I have had a headache since Monday, and I have no allergy to any medicine.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have had a cough since Monday, and I can rest after the pharmacy visit.
dialogue.glossYue: 我由星期一起咳，去完藥房我可以休息。
dialogue.say: I have had a cough since Monday, and I can rest after the pharmacy visit.

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: You can rest at home, and the pharmacy can prepare this prescription for you there.
dialogue.glossYue: 你可以喺屋企休息，藥房嗰度可以幫你配呢張藥單。
dialogue.say: You can rest at home, and the pharmacy can prepare this prescription for you there.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will take the prescription to the pharmacy, and I need a follow-up after rest.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會帶藥單去藥房，休息之後要覆診。
dialogue.say: I will take the prescription to the pharmacy, and I need a follow-up after rest.

dialogue.speaker: wen
dialogue.text: Please rest well, and the clinic can see you for a follow-up after the pharmacy.
dialogue.glossYue: 請你好好休息，去完藥房診所可以同你覆診。
dialogue.say: Please rest well, and the clinic can see you for a follow-up after the pharmacy.

understand.prompt: I have had a fever since Monday. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: I have had 係由某個時間開始一直有。

understand.prompt: You can rest at home. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: You can 係一個建議，唔係命令。

understand.prompt: I need a follow-up. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: follow-up 呢度係覆診，再嚟診所一次。
